description.value: Your phalanx was tasked with reclaiming or finding ways to regain access to the Magnatheca through any means, whether it’s to seek a drachiri that still knew how or to recover or make an Orb of Permafrost, or to find an alternate means to do so. You become trained in Occultism and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.xQQgbsRjFWp7dZhU]{Magnatheca Sync} skill feat, even if you were not a master in Occultism. However, you can only access it once per week while Trained, or once per day if you become an Expert. If you become a Master in Occultism, you gain the feat normally, and if you become Legendary in Occultism, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.MoFlThCPOrJj5t5u]{Magnatheca Transendence} feat automatically.
